sections.①:
• 브랜드명: Adidas
  • 한 줄 정체성: 글로벌 스포츠웨어 — 3선 스트라이프와 트리포일·산봉우리 로고의 헤리티지
  • 공식 디자인 철학: "Impossible is nothing" — 굵은 산세리프 헤드라인 + 검정·흰 강한 대비
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: 3선 스트라이프 + 굵은 산세리프 대문자(SAMBA / GAZELLE / SUPERSTAR) + 검정/흰 모노톤. Nike의 Just Do It 스우시와 정반대의 3선 헤리티지
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 3선스트라이프, 굵은산세리프, 스포츠
  • 무드 설명: 흰 캔버스 + 검정 헤드라인 + 빨강 보조(시즌 캠페인 한정). 사진은 자연광 운동·스니커즈 컷. 헤드라인은 대문자, 카드는 sharp(0px).
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀 + 브루털리즘 (대문자 굵은 헤드라인)
  • 밀도(Density): Comfortable
  • 모서리 성향: Sharp (0px)
  • 평면성: Flat

sections.⑨:
Button

.btn { font: 800 13px/1 AdihausDIN, Helvetica, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px 28px; border: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; }
.btn-primary { background: #000; color: #fff; }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-secondary-500); }
.btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #000; border: 1.5px solid #000; }
.btn-secondary:hover { background: #000; color: #fff; }
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #000; text-decoration: underline; padding: 0; }
.btn-danger { background: var(--color-secondary-500); color: #fff; }
.btn-add-cart { background: #000; color: #fff; padding: 18px; width: 100%; font-size: 14px; }
.btn-arrow { background: #000; color: #fff; padding: 14px 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.btn-arrow::after { content:'→'; }

Input

.input { background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid #000; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 14px; color: var(--text-primary); font: 400 14px/1.3 inherit; }
.input::placeholder { color: var(--text-tertiary); }
.input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-secondary-500); }

Card (Product)

.product { background: #fff; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms ease; }
.product:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
.product .img { aspect-ratio: 1; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F0F0F0, #fff); position: relative; }
.product .img .new { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; background: #000; color: #fff; font: 800 11px/1 inherit; padding: 5px 10px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.product .img .heart { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 8px; font-size: 18px; color: #000; }
.product .body { padding: 12px 0 0; }
.product .label { font: 800 10px/1.2 inherit; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-tertiary); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.product .name { font: 700 14px/1.3 inherit; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 6px; text-transform: capitalize; }
.product .price { font: 700 14px/1 inherit; color: var(--text-primary); }
.product .price .old { font: 500 12px/1 inherit; color: var(--text-tertiary); text-decoration: line-through; margin-left: 6px; }
.product .colors { font: 500 12px/1 inherit; color: var(--text-tertiary); margin-top: 6px; }
.card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); padding: 24px; border-radius: 0; }

Badge / Tag

.tag { padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 0; font: 800 11px/1.4 inherit; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tag-new       { background: #000; color: #fff; }
.tag-sale      { background: var(--color-secondary-500); color: #fff; }
.tag-collab    { background: #fff; color: #000; border: 1.5px solid #000; }   /* Y-3 / Wales Bonner */
.tag-essentials{ background: #000; color: #fff; }
.tag-3-stripes { background: #fff; color: #000; border: 1.5px solid #000; }

Navigation (Top bar)

.topbar { background: #fff; padding: 16px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
.topbar .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.topbar .brand .three { display: inline-flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; }
.topbar .brand .three span { display: inline-block; width: 5px; background: #000; transform: skewX(-20deg); }
.topbar .brand .three span:nth-child(1) { height: 14px; }
.topbar .brand .three span:nth-child(2) { height: 20px; }
.topbar .brand .three span:nth-child(3) { height: 26px; }
.topbar .brand strong { font: 800 22px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-transform: lowercase; }
.topbar .nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; font: 800 13px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.topbar .right { margin-left: auto; display: flex; gap: 18px; align-items: center; font: 500 12px/1 inherit; }
sections.⑪: 1. 3선 스트라이프 형태 변경 금지 — 기울어진 평행 3선이 시그니처 2. 헤드라인을 소문자·세리프로 사용 금지 — 굵은 대문자 산세리프가 정체성 3. 라운드 카드/버튼 사용 금지 — sharp(0px)이 표준 4. 빨강을 본문에 일반화 금지 — 캠페인 한정 5. 다크 모드 캔버스 사용 금지

<style>
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg-base); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: AdihausDIN, Helvetica, 'Pretendard', Arial, sans-serif; }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  .adidas-page { min-width: 320px; background: var(--bg-base); }
  .shipping { height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--color-primary-500); color: var(--text-on-primary); font: 800 10px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .topbar { height: 72px; padding: 0 var(--space-lg); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-xl); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); background: var(--bg-base); }
  .wordmark { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 7px; color: var(--text-primary); }
  .wordmark svg { width: 42px; height: 29px; display: block; }
  .wordmark strong { font-size: 21px; line-height: .9; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.06em; }
  .nav { display: flex; gap: var(--space-lg); font: 800 12px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: .055em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .nav span:first-child { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--text-primary); padding: 28px 0 9px; }
  .tools { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 12px; }
  .hero { min-height: 540px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(300px,.78fr) minmax(420px,1.22fr); background: var(--bg-subtle); overflow: hidden; }
  .hero-copy { padding: clamp(48px,7vw,100px) clamp(28px,5vw,72px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
  .eyebrow { margin: 0 0 var(--space-md); font: 800 11px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: .24em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .hero h1 { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(62px,8vw,122px); font-weight: 900; line-height: .78; letter-spacing: -.065em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .hero-copy p { max-width: 460px; margin: var(--space-lg) 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; }
  .btn-arrow { width: fit-content; background: var(--color-primary-500); color: var(--text-on-primary); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-none); padding: 17px 22px; font: 800 12px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--bg-base),4px 4px 0 1px var(--color-primary-500); }
  .btn-arrow span { margin-left: 18px; font-size: 17px; }
  .hero-art { position: relative; min-height: 460px; background: linear-gradient(145deg,#E9E9E5 0%,#F7F7F7 66%,#E4E4E0 100%); overflow: hidden; }
  .hero-art .number { position: absolute; right: -3%; top: -2%; color: var(--bg-base); font-size: clamp(180px,28vw,430px); line-height: .78; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -.11em; }
  .hero-art .vertical { position: absolute; right: 24px; top: 26px; font: 800 10px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: .22em; writing-mode: vertical-rl; }
  .hero-shoe { position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 78%; left: -1%; bottom: 3%; filter: drop-shadow(0 24px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.13)); }
  .collection { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--space-lg) var(--space-3xl); }
  .section-head { display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-lg); margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); }
  .section-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(32px,4vw,54px); line-height: .9; letter-spacing: -.045em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .section-head a { color: var(--text-primary); font: 800 11px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid; padding-bottom: 4px; }
  .feature-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: var(--space-md); }
  .product { background: var(--bg-elevated); cursor: pointer; }
  .product-image { aspect-ratio: 1.08; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-subtle); transition: background var(--duration-base) var(--ease-out); }
  .product:hover .product-image { background: var(--color-neutral-100); }
  .product-image svg.shoe { width: 92%; height: 78%; position: absolute; left: 4%; bottom: 7%; filter: drop-shadow(0 13px 9px rgba(0,0,0,.13)); transition: transform var(--duration-base) var(--ease-out); }
  .product:hover svg.shoe { transform: translateY(-5px) rotate(-1deg); }
  .flag { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; z-index: 2; background: var(--color-primary-500); color: var(--text-on-primary); padding: 7px 10px; font: 800 9px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: .11em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .heart { position: absolute; right: 13px; top: 12px; z-index: 2; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; }
  .three-lines { position: absolute; right: -22px; bottom: -3px; width: 112px; height: 8px; background: var(--color-primary-500); transform: rotate(-42deg); box-shadow: 0 -16px 0 var(--color-primary-500),0 -32px 0 var(--color-primary-500); opacity: .08; }
  .product-body { padding: 13px 0 var(--space-md); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
  .category { margin-bottom: 5px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font: 800 9px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .product-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; }
  .product-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
  .price { white-space: nowrap; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
  .color-count { margin-top: 6px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 11px; }
  @media (max-width: 780px) {
    .topbar { height: 58px; padding: 0 16px; }.nav,.tools span:first-child { display:none; }.tools { gap: 12px; }
    .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }.hero-copy { min-height: 390px; }.hero-art { min-height: 360px; }
    .feature-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }.collection { padding: 44px 16px 64px; }
  }
</style>
